prompts.name: charcoal
prompts.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: production macOS app icon, one square 1024x1024 PNG with real alpha. Edit target is the supplied user's APPROVED charcoal app icon. Remove ONLY the pale gray/white photographic backdrop and outside drop shadow surrounding the rounded charcoal square. Preserve the complete charcoal rounded-square tile and the silver metallic spork inside it EXACTLY: same centered placement, short FOUR tines with three slots, rounded spoon body, short refined handle, identical proportions, bevel, material, highlights, shading and charcoal color. Do NOT redesign or reinterpret anything. Retain a clean softly antialiased rounded tile silhouette, no white fringe. Keep the complete tile centered with approximately the same 8% transparent inset on each side in a square canvas. The tile itself is opaque, only outside its rounded silhouette is fully transparent. No text, watermark, mockup, presentation background or comparison sheet. One finished icon only.
